scripts.text: You are not in my group are you?
I don't have anything to say to outsiders.
If you want something register with my group.
To register with the Eden Group ask Laime Evenor next to me.
If you have any normal missions use the bulletin board.
I give training missions to members.
That's why they participate in it.
If they don't want to get in trouble, it's essential.
Through battle training they can improve their real experience.
The members that prove themselves will even get a reward.
We gave them special equipmant that we have made.
These gifts are for people who are really doing their best.
If you are curious, you can join.
The training battle course is not very difficult.
If you want to join, don't hesitate.
It's not my business but you should probably reconsider.
Gosh. You wanted to know something about equipment?
I have a uniform set which is free for our group members.
But, I can't give it for free.
We give it to great participants who do their best in the training.
-Boya eyes you from top to bottom.
Hmm... he seems to think something is wrong.-
So, will you join the training or not?
I look a little bit funny, actually I am really busy I was called shining Rune Knight.
-Beats quickly and this shining Rune Knight turns invisible.
Hey, I already talked all about the training areas.
I will explain again please concentrate.
There is a big dog in the center.
The detailed story is written in the log, see?
We will give you a uniform and some equipment.
Can you see a large blue gate next to the board?
Go inside then keep walking until the end of the right passage. There is an equipment storage there.
Inform the manager that I sent you. He will give you some stuff.
The training name was 'Conquer the Culvert!.
Did you explore the culvert fully?
Come back when you've completed all the courses from the local trainer.
My team will give you a uniform and some equipment.
Can you see a large blue gate next to the board?
Go inside then keep walking until the end of the right passage. There is an equipment storage there.
Inform the manager that I sent you. He will give you some stuff.
Get the equipment from the storage manager.
Our uniform is pretty awesome haha.
Um, did you like the supplies?
The red ribbon is really cute.
Able to take upper class, now.
What about it, do you want?
Actually I don't care but the uniform will be changed as upper class.
Let me choose a proper place for you.
The battle training is organized into steps.
When you able to join next step come back again after leveling more.
The next training step is available for those over Level 26.
When you reach that level, come by again. get it?
The training area is at the north cave of Payon.
A staff member is already dispatched there.
Find him and follow his directions.
You finished the second step of training.
Now do you understand how this world is organized?
I will certify that you completed the training.
The person in charge of equipment storage will supply you with what you need.
Choose an equipment that fits your particular set of skills.
The training area is southwest of Morocc.
Enter the Saint Darmain Fortress to reach it directly.
There's someone there named... Uh... he is waiting for you to follow his direction.
You finished the second step of training.
Now do you understand how this world is organized?
I will certify that you completed the training.
The person in charge of equipment storage will supply you with what you need.
We serve trainees with equipment and armor after passing the second step of training.
Go to the storage and meet the person in charge there.
To find the storage pass the blue gate next to the mission board then at the end of the hallway to the right side.
Let me see... which step is good for you...
Sooo sorry but to join this training You need to be at least level 40.
Concentrate to become higher level then come back.
Did you come to see me?
At could have least brought some chocolate...
Banana roll or stripe straw... anything.
Oh, I don't eat snacks with cinnamon...
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee there so you can use the Kafra services.
One of our dispatched members is waiting in the building near the Kafra Employee.
Cool! You passed the third step of training.
I will certify that you completed the training.
The person in charge of equipment storage will supply you with some equipment.
We serve trainees with equipment and armor after passing the second step of training.
Go to the storage and meet the person in charge there.
To find the storage pass the blue gate next to the mission board then at the end of the hallway to the right side.
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee there so you can use the Kafra services there.
One of our dispatched members is waiting in the building near the Kafra Employee.
Cool! You passed the third step of training.
I will certify that you completed the training.
The person in charge of equipment storage will supply you with some equipment.
We serve trainees with equipment and armor after passing the second step of training.
Go to the storage and meet the person in charge there.
To find the storage pass the blue gate next to the mission board then at the end of the hallway to the right side.
First take a ship toward to Bayalan from Izlude!
There is an underground cave. Go in and get to the bottom floor where you will find a historic underwater city..
There is a dispatched trainee around the entrance of the Ocean City.
Cool! You passed the third step of training.
I will certify that you completed the training.
The person in charge of equipment storage will supply you with some equipment.
We serve trainees with equipment and armor after passing the second step of training.
Go to the storage and meet the person in charge there.
To find the storage pass the blue gate next to the mission board then at the end of the hallway to the right side.
If you finish all of the steps go and get your supplies.
We offer equipment to those who complete the training.
We might serve you other things.
If you have any questions, ask the person in charge of the arsenal.
The arsenal is past the blue gate and at the end of the right side of the passage.
My boss created all the courses for the training.
After he manufactured the uniform and supplies he changed his mind and said that he can't give them for free.
People who show their effort for my team and the world can get some supplies.
That's why these courses were made.
Basically we are supposed to offer these supplies for beginners
but if experts want to participate this training, we accept them.
Although the uniform and equipment might be useless.
participating in this training means they want to become a member of our group.
That's why when we decided a hat design it was really difficult.
Remember this when you use the equipment.
But if you decide to sell or trade them off, it is none of our concern.
I doubt that you need more training.
There is nothing more I can teach a battle master such as yourself.
We have a total of 3 steps for the training.
Umm. You should raise your level more!
You need to be at least level 12!
I'm sorry but those are the rules.
The first step is course A.
Course A is called 'Conquer the Desert!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
^4d4dffThere is a desert town called Morocc.
From there go south and then east. There is small oasis in the center of that field.^000000
If you go there, you will find a dog around the oasis.
He is really mysterious and he can speak so don't be suprised.
Tell the dog ^4d4dffBoya is really great.^000000
If you have any questions ask that dog.
Why are you staring at me?
I had to come up with a password right?
Anyway, that place is not far from here so, it is a reasonable place for a beginner like you.
I'll send you to the first step of course B.
Course B is called 'Conquer the Culvert!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
You need to register to explore the culvert in Prontera at the Knight Guild.
After registering there go to the western gate of Prontera. The manager of the culvert is near the entrance.
Once you enter the culvert you can find a dispatched cat. Don't be surprised if he talks to you.
Tell the cat ^4d4dffBoya's help is like a giant and beautiful tuna^000000.
He is really mysterious and he can speak so don't be suprised.
He will give you a battle target when you tell him that.
If you have any questions ask the cat.
Why are you staring at me like that?
It's just a password that I made up.
That place is nor far from here so, it is a reasonable place for a beginner like you.
Let me choose a proper place for you.
I'll send you to the second step of course A.
This course is called 'Conquer the Ghost Cave!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
There is a small archer village north of Payon.
There is a cave on the western hill of the archer village.
We have dispatched someone in front of the cave.
Anyway he is one of us so he will know me.
He will give you a mission.
If you have questions ask him.
Why are you staring at me?
We haven't met for a long time that's why I can't remember his name!
That place is not far from here so, come back quickly.
I'll send you to the 2nd step of course B.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
Travel just southwest of Morocc City.
There you will find a hole in the ground to a cave called Anthell.
There are lots of ants in there. kk?
It is also covered in sand so be careful in there ok.
That's why it's called ant hell.
One of our members will be waiting there.
His name is... K? M? Hmm? Anyway I can't remember.
He is one of us so he will know me.
He will give you a mission.
If you have any questions ask him.
Why are you staring at me?
We haven't met for a long time that's why I can't remember his name!
That place is not far from here so, come back quickly.
You are on the third step of course A.
This course is called 'Conquer Orc village!'.
Go through the gate of Prontera and keep walking to the west. Orc Village is in that direction.
Or you can go out through the western gate of Geffen and keep heading southeast..
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee dispatched there so you could use the Kafra services..
One of our dispatched members is waiting in the building near the Kafra Employee.
She will explain what needs to be done there.
If you have any questions ask her.
You are on the third step of course B.
This course is called 'Conquer Orc dungeon!'.
It's the most proper mission for your level.
Go through the gate of Prontera and keep walking to the west. Orc Village is in that direction.
Or you can go out through the western gate of Geffen and keep heading southeast..
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee dispatched there so you could use the Kafra services..
One of our dispatched members is waiting in the building near the Kafra Employee.
She will explain what needs to be done there.
If you have any questions ask her.
You are on the last step.
This course is called 'Conquer the Ocean City!'.
I don't know if it is the proper course or not, but anyway it's the last course of our training.
First take a ship to Byalan Island from Izlude!
There is an underground cave. Go in and get to the bottom floor where you will find a historic underwater city..
Although it's underwater, you can breath so don't worry.
There is a dispatched trainee around the entrance of the Ocean City.
Tell him that I sent you and follow his directions.
A member of the Eden Group.
Have you come to give me a meal? I don't like drinks.
Gosh, did you come here to participate in the training?
If Boya sent you then you know that it's battle training.
If so, should I start securing this oasis more clearly?
Can you see a Condor flying?
Can you scare them away for me?
So people can use this oasis safer and more comfortably.
We should hunt at least 10 Condors, ok?
I will sleep for a while.
Haven't you seen a talking dog before?
I can feel my youth from you.
Let's find the next target kk!
Ok. Let's drive the Desert Wolves out of here.
If they grow up they will become dangerous.
Why, why are you looking at me like that?
They are wolves and I am a nice dog.
But I haven't always been a dog my entire life.
I will show you that don't have to pity me at all.
They pee wherever and have no shame.
Just waving their tails when they grow up and biting people without any care!
First lets follow the bald and noisy bird.
Kill 10 Condors. It seems to easy, right?
Oh, if you are tired I will help you.
-When the dog barked, your HP and SP recovered.-
Or not. Hehe, anyway thanks for your help.
The oasis has almost been secured now.
There's an annoying monster that hides in the sand and poisons people out of nowhere.
All beautiful things have some poison inside but these actually kill.
Kill Scorpions which are called the poison of the desert!
It's the last step so let's make it simple
I don't want you to show any pity.
I am dog with a golden heart.
After hunting the 10 Desert Wolves come back again.
Oh, if you are tired I will help you.
-When the dog barked, your HP and SP recovered.-
Thanks to your effort the oasis is secure.
If I dig more and more, I can find Scorpions but
this oasis will be safer for sure.
You can be proud and confident by yourself and do your best.
You've helped a lot to make my rest comfortable.
You've helped to conquer the desert,
and passed the beginner training steps so I will stamp my feet.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and show it to the flashy Rune Knight.
Let me say again that you are great!
So we can make peace in this oasis.
When I take a nap they won't chew my tail any more.
Due to his mistake my feet won't be hurt at all.
Other people are going to be safer too.
Everyone will think fondly of the Eden Group.
Oh, if you are tired I will help you.
-When the dog barked, your HP and SP recovered.-
They accepted a wandering talking dog.
Anyway are you a Eden Group member?
I am also a member of Eden Group.
Why are you looking at me like that?
I may be standing here and talking to you like this meow but I am a still a cat meow...
Dear Boya's help is like a giant and...
Where are the big and fresh mackerel meow?
Do you know the big and beautiful tuna?
Dear Boya sent you here for sure.
Did something pass under my feet just now meow?
Do you want to kill a cat.
Anyway I'm doing what I was assigned to do.
Did you come here to have a battle?
Hunt those Thief Bugs, hurry up!
I really don't like those nasty crawlers...
a thief bug and froze in
Now do you understand the dirty and humid underground sewers?
It's a symbol of dirt next to those Thief Bugs.
Hunt some Tarou to make the sewers cleaner.
For our members joining this mission.
Why didn't I ask you at once? kkk..??
Because it's just a training mission.
Training missions are hard and anoying.
So go hurry and hunt 10 Tarou.
Clean the sewers. Now the first step is hunting Thief Bugs.
Take care to check your map so you don't get lost.
How'd you get rid of those dirty bugs and Tarou. You are brave.
Now have courage because I'm sending you to a stronger opponent.
But first in order to test your courage, hunt Familiars.
Familiars will bite you so be careful.
They scare me so just hunt 5 and that should be enough.
That will show me that you are brave.
What do you want meow? Familiars are waiting to fight with you, hurry up, move~!
If you can't kill the Tarou you might get all kinds of dirty diseases.
So be proud of yourself and do your best to kill them.
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
Now you are not scared of bugs and tarou at all.
Thanks for participating in the Conquer the Culvert training mission.
Now go back to the headquarters and ask Instructor Boya to make sure he has the beautiful tuna...
Do you know how to get to the Eden Group Headquarters?
Prontera is the closest city from here.
Go to Prontera and find an Eden Group Teleporter.
It's the last course so cheer up.
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters to report to Boya.
Boya might eat my tuna while he is waiting for you.
Did you volunteer to conquer the Culvert?
You are a member of the Edgen Group for sure.
You are helping to make the world a better place.
You are not the one I am waiting for.
Since I got a report, I was waiting for you.
You came here to join the training mission, right?
Have you ever entered this cave before?
I don't know if you already heard some stories in this village.
There are many of dead souls that change their appearance as if they are real people and make threatening remarks.
That's why we chose this place as step 2 of the battle training mission.
This step is called 'Conquer Ghost Cave~'.
Help people to enjoy their nights comfortably.
There are many dangerous things there. Hmm...
To you the 1st floor is enough.
Lets conquer the dangerous ghost cave...
Kill the bone Skeletons in there.
Actually Skeletons or just normal bones are all the same but...
Skeletons are one of the basic undead classes.
Undead never ever. Hunt 15 undead Skeletons.
If you feel like you're in danger don't hesitate to just leave.
You're not worried about getting hurt are you?
Did you get how the undead work?
As you know undead never die so, blessing of live person it's same as curse to them.
So... skills which can save people like Heal and Resurrection.
Those things are really strong attacks to undead class.
Next... I guess you already see while you were killing Skeletons.
Some green things are picking up all of the stuff dropped by the dead monsters.
Do you know Porings? Maybe they are related to them.
They look really bad, maybe they have been eating poison or something.
Ok if you're ready go and kill those Poporings.
Use the Heal or Resurrection skill.
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
Did you get back what the Poporing stole?
This cave is really deep and there are lots of precious things that they could have picked up.
You did really great job. Excellent.
The 1st floor is safer now. Thanks for helping.
You've completed all of the training missions so go back to the headquarters and get approval from the flashy Rune Knight.
You might get a new uniform.
Haha. I will keep tabs on your progression.
Poporings are stronger than you expect.
If you treat them the same as a normal Poring it will get you in trouble.
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
I already informed Boya at the Eden Group headquarters.
If you go there he will give you a big welcome.
You will get a new uniform, aren't you excited?
Do your best to make the world safer.
It's one of the goals of the Eden Group.
You are a member of my group.
Why did you come here, are you looking for danger?
One of the strongest boss monsters is in here.
We are not related to each other, are we...
Why did you come here, looking for danger?
Uh. Conquer Ant Hell? Did you say that?
You have come to the right place.
At first I will explain about Ant Hell.
Ants dug a cave in the sand and it is linked to the surface. That's Ant Hell.
Sand flowed into the hole gradually.
If anyone steps on the hole they will fall into the cave through the hole in the sand..
It's hard to survive from there.
To us it seems like a normal happening so it isn't a matter of survival like to normal people.
Many kinds of ants have come to live here.
There is a boss monster named Maya so you should be more cautious.
Ok let's try to hunt the weakest ant first.
Pierre is the name of the weakest ant.
In the case of ants, they assist eachother when attacked.
Be careful and kill 15 Pierre ants.
You are exhausted from the extremely hot weather in the desert.
One of the trainees was planning to visit me but that person still hasn't showed yet. I am getting nervous.
You are in Anth Hell southwest of Morocc.
Morocc is the closest city, northeast of here.
Maybe you saw an Andre when you were hunting Pierre.
Well, now let's hunt Andre aswel.
Ahah the way you're looking at me, ''why didn't I ask you to do this all at once'' right?
Ain't it more fun this way?
Hey, now your next target is 15 Andre!
You are strong so it will be fine!
If you can't find Andre go deeper into the cave.
Ah, and be careful of Maya.
What do you think of Ant Hell?
Ok, I will recover your strengh so, keep going.
Great. You seem to have killed all of the Andre.
How do you think about fighting ants?
To conquer Ant Hell you have one step left.
You might have guessed your next target already.
How can I say... He seems like honey.
Pierre is a worker. Andre is a guardian and so... Vitata is like a mother.
They are really kind to kids and women but don't show any pity to ants.
Hunt the Vitata who takes care of the ant eggs.
If somebody falls into Ant Hell it might be a bit safer than before.
Now it's the last step so cheer up and let's kill 10 Vitata.
If you feel you're in too much danger. Just come back.
See, to cheer you up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Oh... it might have been an anoying fight.
Good job. Go back to the headquarters and report.
You did a really good job even under the hot weather.
See, to cheer up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Just Vitata, isn't that an easy opponent?
If you see Maya just run away.
It's enough to say that you've conquered Ant Hell.
Aren't you getting used to it here?
Go back to the headquarters and report that you completed the mission, hurry up
You will receive the Eden Group uniform aswel.
I am really proud of the Eden Group.
Does the uniform look good on me?
Unbelievable why did you come here?
Um... You are not on the third step of the training?
I am a little bored waiting for trainees. Where are they?
Why don't you join my group?
If you have interest in joining us,
Actually I don't like this training mission much but anyway let me explain it to you.
As you know this is Orc Village.
They don't try to communicate with us. When they see humans they immediately attack us.
Sadly humans don't want to communicate with them either.
So we decided to take a strong approach towards them.
Actually we'd like to get rid of them all.
We're trying to conquer Orc Village.
It's the proper place to finish the beginners training mission for an adventurer like you.
That's why we've chosen this place for this mission.
Ok, we don't have a lot of time so let's begin.
First let's eliminate the weakest one.
It's better to kill them before they grow up.
Don't pity them because when they grow up they become aggressive Orc Warriors.
Good or bad this is how it is going to be.
Even if they are babies don't hesitate.
It's not very pleasant so let's move on.
On the next step we will fight with Orc Warriors.
When Orc Babies grow up they become strong Orc Warriors.
When you were fighting Orc Babies, you probably have been attacked by them.
Now it's time to hunt 10 Orc Warriors.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
There are Orc Warriors, Orc Ladies and Orc Babies in Orc Village.
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
Now you can move on to the next step.
Exactly... now it's time to hunt Orc Ladies.
If you want to conquer Orc Village completely, you should kill them before they have more Orc Babies.
But you don't need to kill all of them.
You can already feel the strong power from outside...
You should be exhausted by now.
But you still have more targets, understand.
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
Now you should understand how the orc tribe works here in Orc Village.
You've followed the training mission well under hot and humid circumstances.
You have now completed the 'Conquer Orc Village!' training mission. Congratulations.
Go back and report to the Eden Group headquarters.
I'm sure they will have good news for you.
Orc Lady is the last target.
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
You have completed the training mission.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report there.
Have you come here to join in the training?
This isn't a good place to talk so let's hurry.
This place is linked with the dungeon of Orc Village.
There is a cave under the ground, normal orcs don't come here.
The safest place is in here.
There are many undead monsters down there.
The undead monsters are dangerous and threatening.
Now hunt those undead monsters down there.
Try to hunt 20 Orc zombies in the dungeon.
They will attack you anywhere without hesitating.
It's different from what you saw in Payon, right?
Although you managed to kill the Orc Zombies, you can't be sure you are much stronger..
So don't go deeper into that cave or you will die for sure.
The next target is the Orc Skeleton who was walking next to the Orc Zombies.
It's the last step of the training mission in the Orc Dungeon.
Ok, cheer up and see you again.
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
Your training mission has been completed.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report.
I would like to say more in detail but I'm getting so tired.
Recently trainees have come here more and more so, I can't sleep at all.
I mean not due to you.
Anyway I will inform the group so go there and report.
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
Don't you have to report back to the Eden Group headquarters?
I am so tired leave me alone.
Uh? What Orc? Explore the dungeon?
You are having such a hard time.
This place is really good to take a rest because Orcs don't come here.
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
Mysteriously although we're under the sea you can still breathe here.
Let's see due to the moisture my skin is so soft.
My fingers and toes are not attached to each other amazing.
I was really shocked and scared when the Eden Group dispatched me here.
Now I love this environment so much.
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
Ancient buildings are sleeping under the water. They were actually built under the sea.
As you know we don't have any trouble living here.
But if you see over there... yes right there.
Can you see a humanoid fish with a very threatening spear?
He is called a Merman and is a really professional warrior.
That will be your 1st training mission here.
What did you think of those threatening Mermans?
Actually, I thought that you would chicken out~
Good your next opponent will be...~
The monster that is holding a trident.
Now, it's time to fight with a real magician!
Try avoiding the Mermans and hunt 10 Strouf, kill them.
I will help you recover so cheer up.
Did you kill all the Strouf already?
I wasn't counting that you'd make it.
I have eyes on the top of my head haha.
Don't look at me like that~ it was a joke~!
Now you're feeling more at ease about this.
Go back to the headquarters and report it.~
You will receive the last uniform from the Eden Group headquarters.
This training mission is made for beginners.
So it might be useless to you or not.
I can help you recover so cheer up.
I won't give help to you anymore.
Go back to our headquarters and report about this training mission.
Mysteriously although we're under the sea you can still breathe here.
Let's see due to the moisture my skin is so soft.
My fingers and toes are not attached to each other amazing.
I was really shocked and scared when the Eden Group dispatched me here.
Now I love this environment so much.
we can supply you with a Eden Group Hat, Uniform, Manteau and Boots.
Make sure you have enough room for the supplies.
Two of the supplies, the ^4d4dffHat and Manteau^000000,
will only be given out once.
So treat them with caution and care.
As for the Boots and the Uniforms, you will receive better quality ones based on your course grades.
One pair of Eden Group Boots I.
A total of 4 supplies, that's all.
It is manufactured for beginners so they don't have the best effect but they're still cheaper than equipment in the shops.
We made them especially for the Eden Group.
If you've completed step 2, we offer extra weapons including the basic equipment.
We have chosen the proper weapon for each class.
But we can't support some classes that can't join us.
We can't manufacture all of the weapons in the world, don't you agree?
We will supply 1 Weapon, Shoes and Uniform so a total of three things.
Also we supply extra things to consider some members who can't use some of the supplies.
^4d4dffPlease check your inventory to get those items.^000000
Let me see... you will receive..
the Eden Group Boots II and Uniform II.
I don't know what weapon will suit you so, you'll get a Dagger.
You don't have a record of receiving any supplies
so, you'll receive the Eden Group Hat and Manteau aswell.
Check your supplies again and look after it.
A Weapon, Uniform and Boots all 3 supplies.
I don't know what weapon will suit you so, you'll get a Dagger.
I hope they're useful to you.
You've completed the last training course.
It's time for you to receive a new weapon.
We have more upgraded weapons, uniforms and boots.
Ah, in case of the weapon that was made only for 1st jobs.
So, I can't offer them to higher jobs.
^4d4dffPlease check you inventory to get those supplies.^000000
Make sure you have enough room.
Let me see... you will receive..
the Eden Group Boots III and Uniform III.
You don't have a record of receiving any supplies
so, you'll receive the Eden Group Hat and Manteau aswell.
Check your supplies again and look after it.
A Uniform and Boots all 2 supplies.
I hope they're useful to you.
Sorry, but I can't find any record that you can obtain supplies.
We store weapons, armor and other goods which were created by the Eden Group here.
We also have a lot of special stuff.
To prepare for emergencies, we hav enough equipment and supplies for an entire army.
Frankly... we don't have a use for it now but in case soemthing happens like in Morocc.
Just take a look around and don't touch anything.
If I make a mistake, Reke will punish me.
